action: CSIRT Italy recommends updating the vulnerable products, following Adobe's bulletins APSB26-104 (Experience Manager) and APSB26-194 (Campaign).
date_note: The CSIRT Italy page gives only its own publication day (25 November); Adobe's bulletin day was not read.
exec: Adobe has released fixes for 113 vulnerabilities in Experience Manager and Campaign Classic, according to Italy's CSIRT.
plain: Adobe released security updates for 113 vulnerabilities in Experience Manager and Campaign Classic, according to Italy's national CSIRT. Its bulletin does not list any exploitation.

sources.name: CSIRT Italy (ACN): Adobe, aggiornamenti di sicurezza

summary: CSIRT Italy says Adobe has released security updates to fix 113 vulnerabilities in Experience Manager and Campaign Classic. It lists the impacts as arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation and security feature bypass. Its table shows no exploitation or proof-of-concept information for the CVEs it lists, and it recommends updating the vulnerable products.
title: CSIRT Italy: Adobe releases updates for 113 vulnerabilities in Experience Manager and Campaign Classic

validation.note: Only the CSIRT Italy (ACN) bulletin was read; Adobe's own bulletin page (helpx.adobe.com) returned 403.

evidence.quote: Adobe ha rilasciato aggiornamenti di sicurezza per risolvere 113 vulnerabilità.
